answer: New agents enter via a bounded-degree sponsorship graph: each agent may mint one sponsee per epoch, locking 20,000 POA behind it. This trellis of one-to-one edges caps a clique's fan-in, so no actor can fabricate a summit of fake identities. 1,000 sybils need 1,000 distinct sponsors locking 20,000,000 POA, versus one honest fee. Enforcement: if a sponsee proves sybil, the sponsor's bond is slashed 100% (half burned, half to the reporter) and its identity is banned 10 epochs. Without a sponsor the mesa stays flat. Limitation: it favors capital-rich incumbents and adds cold-start friction.
